command:
npm install --no-save --no-package-lock playwright@1.56.1 >/dev/null 2>&1
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium >/dev/null 2>&1
python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 1
export OUT=/tmp
set +e
echo '=== unit'
node --test tests/web/wiring.mjs tests/web/context-aging.mjs tests/web/coach.mjs tests/web/agents-plan.mjs tests/web/text-quality.mjs tests/web/learning.mjs tests/web/model-scores.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E '^(# (tests|pass|fail)|not ok)'
for t in model-list ultra ultra-board theme composer-fixes harness prompt-cache claude-api github queue activity-state reasoning approval-card steer-now chat-url; do
  timeout 280 node tests/web/$t.cjs > /tmp/web-$t.log 2>&1
  code=$?
  echo "$t: $(grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/web-$t.log) PASS, $(grep -c '^FAIL' /tmp/web-$t.log) FAIL, exit $code"
  grep '^FAIL' /tmp/web-$t.log | cut -c1-300
done
if [ -f tests/web/pr-watch.cjs ]; then timeout 200 node tests/web/pr-watch.cjs > /tmp/web-pr-watch.log 2>&1; echo "pr-watch: $(grep -c '^PASS' /tmp/web-pr-watch.log) PASS, $(grep -c '^FAIL' /tmp/web-pr-watch.log) FAIL"; grep '^FAIL' /tmp/web-pr-watch.log | cut -c1-300; fi
exit 0
